entities.name: Fall of the Sarpadian Empires
entities.description: A series of wars and events during the Dark Age that ended the Sarpadian empires.

entities.name: Sarpadia
entities.description: An island continent ruled by small empires.

entities.name: Reod Dai
entities.description: Hired by the elves to pit orcs and humans against each other; he united goblin and orc tribes and incited the thrull rebellion.

entities.name: Havenwood elves
entities.description: Elves who cultivated thallids as food and were overrun by the thallid revolt.

entities.name: Thallids
entities.description: Fungal creatures cultivated by elves that gained sentience and revolted.

entities.name: Thrulls
entities.description: Servants of the Order of the Ebon Hand who rebelled.

entities.name: Order of the Ebon Hand
entities.description: Sarpadian empire destroyed by the thrull rebellion.

entities.name: Crimson Peaks dwarven empire
aliases: dwarven empire of the Crimson Peaks
entities.description: Dwarven empire overthrown by the goblin and orc horde.

entities.name: Icatia
entities.description: A Sarpadian empire conquered by the goblins and orcs.

entities.name: Vodalia
entities.description: A Sarpadian empire that fell to invading homarids.

entities.name: Tymolin Loneglade
entities.description: Murdered in a ritual sacrifice by Oliver Farrel.

entities.name: Tev Loneglade
entities.description: Planeswalker who went insane after his brother's murder and urged goblins and orcs to attack Icatia.

entities.name: Empress Galina
entities.description: Vodalian empress accidentally transported over 3000 years into the future.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Invaders who attacked Vodalia and rule the seas around Sarpadia.

entities.name: Trokair
entities.description: Location beyond Montford attacked by invaders.

entities.name: Montford
entities.description: Outpost over which Tev opened a Planar Gate.

events.summary: The elves hire Reod Dai to pit orcs and humans against each other; he unites goblin and orc tribes into one horde.
events.quote: the elves hired Reod Dai to pit the two against each other

events.summary: Reod Dai's magic gives thallids sentience and he incites the thrull rebellion against the Ebon Hand.
events.quote: Reod Dai then incited a rebellion among the thrulls against their Ebon Hand masters.

events.summary: Tymolin Loneglade is murdered in a ritual sacrifice by Oliver Farrel.
events.quote: Tymolin Loneglade was murdered by the zealot Oliver Farrel

events.summary: Tev Loneglade goes insane, becomes Tevesh Szat and urges goblins and orcs to attack Icatia.
events.quote: went insane, assuming the identity of Tevesh Szat

events.summary: Tev opens a Planar Gate over Montford, letting invaders attack the outpost and Trokair.
events.quote: He opened a Planar Gate over Montford

events.summary: Fleeing homarids, Empress Galina is transported over 3000 years into the future; Vodalia falls.
events.quote: Empress Galina was accidentally transported over 3000 years into the future

events.summary: The thrull rebellion destroys the Ebon Hand, thallids overrun Havenwood, and Icatia is conquered.
events.quote: the thrull rebellion destroyed the Ebon Hand

relations.quote: Tymolin's brother, the planeswalker Tev Loneglade
Tymolin Loneglade was murdered by the zealot Oliver Farrel
